Question 2

Find the parametric equations of the hyperbola shown above given that its asymptotes are y=±2x.

a
x=tan⁡t,y=2sec⁡t
b
x=sec⁡t,y=tan⁡t
c
x=sec⁡t,y=2tan⁡t
d
x=2tan⁡t,y=4sec⁡t
e
x=2tan⁡t,y=sec⁡t
